integrity: The characteristic factorization, crossing derivative and first Lyapunov coefficient are derived from the printed equations. The bundled checker uses exact rational complex arithmetic and standard-library Gaussian elimination. Search failure is not treated as a proof of novelty, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local near the origin and \\(a=0\\) for the printed polynomial vector field. The Hopf classification uses the smooth real-\\(a\\) extension; the resulting stable periodic branch lies for sufficiently small positive \\(a\\). No claim is made about the remote four-scroll attractors or large-\\(a\\) periodic windows.
title: The reported Hopf-zero point in a four-scroll flow is an ordinary supercritical Hopf point
